primitives.name: Avatar Modeling

Dualities emerge between real-world motion and virtual avatar behavior, with failure modes tied to data integrity and algorithmic robustness. The system's design assumes consistent sensor calibration and sufficient data for pose estimation, which may break down in dynamic environments or under adversarial conditions.
